Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/jbig2dec && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Use annex-h as base and try a simple mutation to stress MMR-plane progression
base=Path('../../src-vul/jbig2dec/annex-h.jbig2').read_bytes()
for i in range(5):
    data=bytearray(base)
    for j in range(0, min(32, len(data))):
        data[j] ^= (1 << (i%8))
    Path(f'/workspace/poc{i}.bin').write_bytes(data)
PY
for i in 0 1 2 3 4; do echo '=== '$i '==='; cd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/jbig2dec && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.libs ./.libs/jbig2dec -q -o /dev/null /workspace/poc$i.bin >/tmp/run$i.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; tail -5 /tmp/run$i.log; done
